objective:
Add the SIGNUP / account-recovery feature to services/agents-ui using the shared auth-api client at `@/lib/authApi`. CLIENT-only; do NOT touch backend, .github/workflows/ci.yml, or src/router/** (add only src/features/signup/routes.ts via the spec-022 FeatureRouteModule convention). These are PUBLIC routes (no auth required, must not trigger auth-restoration). Follow the established feature pattern (inspect the merged src/features/account and src/features/admin): src/features/signup/{views,components,services,stores,types,routes.ts}, PrimeVue + Tailwind UI, Zod validation, vitest tests, vue-web-commons Toast/messages. Match antfu lint rules already learned in this codebase (all `import type` before value imports; external pkgs [primevue/*, vue] before internal `@/` before relative `../`, alphabetical by source within a group; primevue/* sorts before vue; case-insensitive named import sort; lowercase describe titles; function-property method signatures; `new TypeError` for type-guard throws; `} catch {`/`} else {` one-line; `;` member delimiters; NO '/api/v1' literals or window.location host discovery in feature code; reuse `// eslint-disable-line ts/consistent-type-assertions` only where a cast is needed; provide an explicit arg to vitest mockResolvedValue; use fresh Response per fetch mock if a Response is reused across calls).

Auth-api public endpoints (paths relative to the client base which appends /api/v1; all under the auth origin):
  - POST /users/register  body RegisterUserRequest { username: string; email: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; password: string }
  - GET  /auth/confirm-email?token=<token>  (may return 2xx JSON or a redirect; treat any 2xx as confirmed)
  - POST /auth/resend-confirmation  body { email: string }
  - POST /auth/forgot-password  body { email: string }
  - POST /auth/reset-password  body { token: string; newPassword: string }

Implement:
1) types/index.ts: TS types + Zod schemas for RegisterUserRequest (with client-side rules: non-empty username, valid email, non-empty names, password min length e.g. 8 + a confirm-password match check in the form layer), ResendConfirmationRequest, ForgotPasswordRequest, ResetPasswordRequest.
2) services/signupService.ts: register(body), confirmEmail(token) [GET with encoded token query], resendConfirmation(email), forgotPassword(email), resetPassword(token, newPassword) using the auth-api client.
3) views:
   - RegisterView.vue (/register): registration form (username,email,firstName,lastName,password,confirmPassword) with Zod validation + confirm-match; on success show a 'check your email to confirm' state with a resend-confirmation action; surface AuthApiError (e.g. duplicate username/email) inline/Toast.
   - ConfirmEmailView.vue (/confirm-email): read `token` from route query on mount, call confirmEmail; show confirming/success/failure states; on failure offer resend-confirmation (email input).
   - ForgotPasswordView.vue (/forgot-password): email form -> forgotPassword -> neutral 'if the account exists, a reset link was sent' success (do not leak existence).
   - ResetPasswordView.vue (/reset-password): read `token` from route query; newPassword + confirm form with Zod -> resetPassword -> success state linking to login.
   Use the repo's existing form/card/Toast conventions; keep components small (extract a shared PasswordFields or AuthCard component if helpful). CRITICAL — FORM ERROR HANDLING: use the `useFormErrors()` composable from `@/lib/vueWebCommons` EXACTLY as in services/agents-ui/src/features/projects/components/CreateProjectForm.vue and src/features/repositories/components/CreateRepositoryForm.vue (read them). i.e. `const formErrors = useFormErrors()`, bind `<FormErrors :error="formErrors.general.value" />` (FormErrors expects a FormErrorBanner, NOT a string) and `<FormField :error="formErrors.fieldErrorFor('fieldName')" />` (returns string|undefined). Populate from a caught AuthApiError via the composable's API (mirror how those forms call it — e.g. capturing the error into formErrors). Do NOT introduce ad-hoc `ref<string | null>` general/field error state bound to FormErrors/FormField — that causes typecheck failures (string|null not assignable to FormErrorBanner|null or string|undefined). For PasswordFields error props, accept/pass `string | undefined` (not `string | null`). Run vue-tsc mentally: every `:error` binding must match the component's prop type.
4) routes.ts: default FeatureRouteModule { feature: 'signup', routes: [ { path: '/register', name: 'register', component: () => import('./views/RegisterView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: false } }, { path: '/confirm-email', name: 'confirm-email', component: () => import('./views/ConfirmEmailView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: false } }, { path: '/forgot-password', name: 'forgot-password', component: () => import('./views/ForgotPasswordView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: false } }, { path: '/reset-password', name: 'reset-password', component: () => import('./views/ResetPasswordView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: false } } ], navigation: [] }  (no primary nav entries; these are reached via links/email).
5) Tests (vitest, lowercase describe): signupService maps each endpoint (mocked auth-api client, confirmEmail encodes token in query); RegisterView validates + submits + shows confirm-sent state + handles error; ConfirmEmailView reads token from query and renders success/failure (mock service + vue-router route query); ForgotPasswordView neutral success; ResetPasswordView validates match + submits. Mock $route/useRoute query as needed.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `build`. Reuse PrimeVue components already used in the repo; no heavy new deps.
